lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Officials said the strike at the Benghazi Naval Base severely damaged a Russian ship and ignited a fire after several sea drones were launched from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, The Canadian Press reports.
COP31 climate talks collapse after member states reject deal for not mentioning fossil fuels, CBC News reports.
Abdul El-Sayed doubles down on ‘TrumpCare’ health plan, urging president to ‘get it done’, The Guardian reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
